name: Trip Planner
description: Plan a trip end to end. Editors of the space create trips and build each one out across three views: a day-by-day itinerary with times, activities and places, a packing list grouped by category with live packed counts, and a running log of trip costs with a total. Places you name are looked up once (OpenStreetMap's Nominatim, near the trip's destination) and pinned on an OpenFreeMap map above the itinerary; the frame's server half fetches both for the page. Everyone else — members, and anyone the frame is published to — sees a live read-only itinerary, so a share link doubles as the trip's handout. Trips are the space's own tables (trips, trip_itinerary, trip_packing, trip_expenses), synced with it, and every change reaches every viewer live.
